definitions.explanation: The relative position, level, or class of a person, organization, or thing within a hierarchy. Indicates social standing, prestige, or grade.
A rule, standard, or established convention that serves as a benchmark.
In linguistics, the grammatical relationship of a noun or pronoun to other words in a sentence (e.g., nominative, accusative).

examples.english: They are on a different level.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{格|かく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格|かく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: His standing as an athlete has risen another notch.

examples.japanese: {格|かく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧だ。

examples.japanese: {格|かく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{則|のっと}って→則る：09030_nottoru⟧⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{助詞|じょし}→助詞：03351_joshi⟧が{格|かく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしている→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese, particles serve the role of grammatical case.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (status/rank) is the most common in everyday use. The expression {格|かく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ means someone or something is on a completely different (usually higher) level. {格|かく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧/⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ indicates higher/lower standing.

Appears in many compounds:
- ⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧: gap, disparity
- ⟦{格式|かくしき}→格式：16025_kakushiki⟧: formality, status
- ⟦{格上|かくうえ}→格上：07405_kakuue⟧: higher-ranked
- ⟦{格下|かくした}→格下：07406_kakushita⟧: lower-ranked
- ⟦{格付|かくづ}け→格付け：13121_kakuzuke⟧: rating, ranking
- {主格|しゅかく}: nominative case
- {対格|たいかく}: accusative case

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格|かく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: to be on a different level
- {格|かく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to rise in standing
- {格|かく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to match the standard
